verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API development and testing client: it builds and sends requests, organizes collections, runs a CLI, and exposes collections through an MCP server. It is not a runtime gateway that sits in the production path of LLM/MCP traffic. Proxying and governing that traffic (token limits, prompt guards, provider routing) belongs to the API/AI-gateway category. Nothing in the evidence shows Hoppscotch shipping a traffic-governance layer, so this story is a category error for this product.
